summary: Markets show a risk-off and highly selective tone: Bitcoin reversed its Nvidia-driven rally and traded near $59,700, while the dollar eased after reaching a nearly two-year high.[2][10] Altcoin sentiment remains cautious, with Ethereum still range-bound and Michael van de Poppe describing any recovery as relief rather than a confirmed bull trend.[3]
